text:
marco: alert from monitoring — SCIM deprovision error rate jumped to ~11% at 10:22 UTC, lots of 403s showing in provisioner logs. Anyone touch role ARNs or RBAC?
sara: I ran a small TF change at 10:05 that renamed the deployer role used by the SCIM job (scim-deployer -> scim-deployer-2026). Didn’t change key policies.
marco: can you paste the provisioner error?
sara: log snippet: 
```
2026-03-30T10:20:58Z ERROR scim-deprov decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:999888777666:key/7aa1b2c3
```
audrey: that pattern is a KMS key policy deny — if the new role ARN isn’t in the policy decrypts fail and deprovisions get stuck or retried. KMS replies are opaque.
oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2026-2984 "SCIM deprovision KMS AccessDenied after role rename" — paging eng-platform & SRE
marco: quick plan: 1) add new role ARN to key policy 2) keep old ARN for 24h grace 3) restart scim deployer pods to flush KMS contexts 4) run backfill for the window 5) file follow-ups for runbook/CI linting
sara: applying key policy patch now, will include both ARNs and a Condition limiting to our account.
devops-bot: key policy updated at 10:32 UTC (change-id kp-3042)
audrey: once updated, do a rolling restart to clear cached KMS contexts: kubectl rollout restart deployment/scim-deployer -n idp
sara: restarted, seeing decrypts succeed in logs: 
```
2026-03-30T10:35:12Z INFO scim-deprov decrypt succeeded item=svcacc-17
```
marco: running backfill for 10:00-10:32 window in 100 item batches, monitoring failures.
marco: first batch finished — 5 previously failed items processed, 0 failures now.
audrey: follow-ups: add RBAC rename checklist that includes KMS key policy update, add CI check that flags principal ARN diffs against key policies, and improve correlation ids in SCIM->KMS logs.
oncall-bot: incident INC-2026-2984 resolved — root cause: role rename not added to KMS key policy; remediation: updated key policy, restarted provisioner, ran backfill. Closing."
